request_text: The cover on the fire alarm pull station is cracked.
A ground floor window in our suite won't lock.
The lids are missing from the garbage bins at the loading dock.
The front door lock is jammed and I can't get out of my apartment.
A sprinkler pipe in the parkade is dripping onto a parked car.
The furnace filter light is on.
Water is running down the corridor wall and the floor is wet.
The fire door to the stairwell does not close by itself.
The keypad on the server room door isn't working.
The bathroom door won't close properly.
The washing machine hose burst and water is running down the basement stairs.
A fire extinguisher is blocked by stacked boxes in the corridor.
Pigeons are nesting on the balcony.
The atrium skylight leaks when it rains.
A mouse ran across the kitchen floor.
The water cooler is leaking a little onto the floor.
The smoke alarm is missing from the living room ceiling since the ceiling repair.
Two ceiling lights in the hallway flicker.
Emergency lighting in the stairwell did not come on during yesterday's power flicker.
Smell of burning plastic from the electrical panel in the basement.
A gutter has pulled away from the building.
The exit sign in our stairwell flickers on and off.
There is no water in the whole building.
The smoke alarm went off while we cooked toast, so we pulled it off the wall. It is on the table now.
The ceiling paint is bubbling above the bathroom.
The dryer outlet has melted.
A tree branch is resting on the power line to our house.
The office is 29 degrees, the AC isn't working and staff are struggling.
Our CO alarm is chirping for a low battery. We have a gas furnace.
The fire alarm panel beeps every few minutes and shows ground fault.
